risks.title: Economic Fluctuations and Capital Spending
risks.score_rationale: The company's financial results closely follow changes in general economic conditions and capital spending levels in the industries it serves. Demand for most products depends on new capital investment and maintenance expenditures by customers. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Economic fluctuations can have a significant impact on the company's financial results through changes in customer capital expenditure patterns.

risks.title: Foreign Currency Fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: A significant portion of revenues (54% for year ended December 31, 2025) is denominated in currencies other than the U.S. dollar, and much of manufacturing and labor costs are also outside the U.S., creating exposure to exchange rate movements. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Foreign exchange rate fluctuations can impact operating results due to significant international revenue and cost exposure.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in highly competitive markets where it faces competition on product quality, reliability, pricing, and service responsiveness. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Intense competition can significantly impact market share and pricing power in the company's operating segments.

risks.title: Technology Dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company relies on technology for its operations, making systems vulnerable to security breaches and operational disruptions. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Dependence on technology systems creates vulnerability to security failures and operational interruptions.

risks.title: Regulatory Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulations in the countries where it operates, which can impact operations and financial results. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Regulatory changes can impact operations and financial results across the company's global footprint.

risks.title: Supply Chain Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company depends on suppliers for raw materials and components such as steel, aluminum, copper, and castings, making operations vulnerable to supply chain disruptions. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Supply chain disruptions could impact the company's ability to manufacture and deliver products to customers.

risks.title: Reputation Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company's reputation for product quality, reliability, and service is essential to maintaining long-standing customer relationships and market positions. Incidents could significantly impact financial results. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Reputation damage could significantly impact customer relationships and financial performance given brand reliance.
